_meta.description: Seed catalog of commonly used released CDS views (VDM I_* interface / C_* consumption / A_* OData-aligned) in S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition. Last expanded: 2026-08-04 covering all major modules. A miss here is NOT 'unreleased' — released-VDM naming is recognised by check_object_release_state.
authoritative_sources: SAP Help — Released CDS Views (Public Cloud): https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_S4HANA_CLOUD/c0c54048d35849128be8e872df5bea6d/5418de55938d1d22e10000000a44147b.html
ADT Released Objects tree — filter by release contract 'Use in Cloud Development' (C1)
View Browser app (Fiori) in your tenant
SAP Business Accelerator Hub > CDS Views: https://api.sap.com/products/SAPS4HANACloud/apis/all
_meta.naming_convention: Released VDM views: I_ (interface), C_ (consumption/analytical), A_ (OData API-aligned), R_/E_. P_ (private) views are NOT released for cloud development.
_meta.verification_rule: Release contract (C1 developer, or analytics release for key user) MUST be confirmed per view on the Released CDS Views list or ADT. Classical tables listed under 'replaces' are NOT accessible in Public Cloud custom code.
